# How The Nash Supports the Local Community

From day one, [The Nash Casino](https://thenashcasino.com/) has embraced its role as a community partner by using charitable gaming to make a meaningful difference across Nashua and Southern New Hampshire.

It’s the state’s largest entertainment destination and continues to demonstrate a deep commitment to giving back. The team behind The Nash builds long-lasting local partnerships and selects charities that provide essential services and community events in Nashua. Through record-breaking donations and a transparent process, The Nash Casino proves that gaming and generosity go hand in hand\! 

## 

## How Does Charitable Gaming in New Hampshire Work?

​​![][image1]  
*Alt text: A casino gaming floor with gaming machines to represent how charitable casinos support community events in Nashua*

In the state of New Hampshire, charitable gaming allows eligible organizations to offer “Games of Chance.” All charities must meet strict licensing and compliance requirements set by the New Hampshire Lottery Commission’s Investigation and Compliance Division.

Participants must be domestic nonprofit organizations registered with the IRS as tax-exempt. It must also be in good standing with the New Hampshire Charitable Trust (for 501(c)(3) organizations) and be registered with the New Hampshire Secretary of State for at least one year. This structure ensures accountability, transparency, and trust, all key pillars of charitable gaming support.

## 

## The Nash Makes a Big Impact: Record-Breaking Contributions

The impact of The Nash was both immediate and historic. Just one month after opening, the casino donated an astonishing $1.5 million to eight nonprofit organizations across Southern New Hampshire. According to the New Hampshire Lottery Commission, this was unprecedented in the state’s gaming industry. And that momentum has only continued.

In the first ten months of operations, The Nash generated an unprecedented $15.4 million for New Hampshire nonprofits.

“As the state’s [largest charitable gaming venue](https://thenashcasino.com/gaming), giving back to the community is a central part of who we are,” said General Manager Eric Althaus. “Whether it’s helping families in need, supporting the arts, local students, or area veterans, it is incredibly gratifying to help make a difference in the lives of our neighbors.”

These contributions reflect the casino’s financial success and its steadfast commitment to lifting up community events in Nashua.

## 

## A Community-Focused Selection Process

At the heart of The Nash’s giving efforts is the Casino Charity Selection Committee. Their mission is clear: to provide a transparent, fair, and equitable process for selecting and scheduling New Hampshire charities to participate. The committee evaluates each organization’s mission and compliance carefully. They prioritize those with a meaningful reach in the local Nashua community.

Special consideration is also given to charities that support essential services, like law enforcement, first responders, veterans, food scarcity programs, housing initiatives, education, youth programs, and the arts.

Overall, the Nash focuses on initiatives that align with the local community’s values. This guarantees that charitable gaming support addresses real needs directly. The Casino Charity Selection Committee’s thoughtful approach has helped foster strong Nashua local partnerships that extend far beyond the casino floor.

## 

## Supporting the Local Causes That Matter Most

The Nash’s charitable contributions have benefited a wide range of organizations, each strengthening the local community.

### Youth Programs and Education

Organizations like the Boys & Girls Club of the Souhegan Valley received nearly $169,000. This is exactly the type of funding that leaders say can be truly life-changing. Scholarships awarded through groups such as the Souhegan Scholarship Foundation are expanding access to higher education and career training, with funding expected to increase both the number and value of awards.

### Food Insecurity and Housing

Food pantries and housing-focused nonprofits have also benefited significantly. The Hudson Community Food Pantry received one of the largest single gifts in its history, allowing it to continue serving food-insecure residents. Harbor Homes and similar organizations are using funds to support housing stability and essential services.

### Veterans, First Responders, and Service Organizations

Veterans organizations, including American Legion and VFW posts, as well as Operation Care for Troops, have received substantial funding from The Nash. These contributions help support everything from emergency assistance to the purchase and shipment of essential supplies for troops and at-risk veterans, especially during harsh winter months.

### Arts and Culture

The Nash also proudly supports cultural organizations such as the Nashua Community Music School and the Nashua International Sculpture Foundation, recognizing the importance of creativity and expression.

### Supporting Education Across the State

Charitable gaming at The Nash also supports the future of the entire state of New Hampshire. According to New Hampshire law, a portion of gaming revenues is directed to the state’s Education Trust Fund.

Specifically, 10% of games of chance revenue and 16.5% of historical horse racing (HHR) revenue are contributed to the fund. In June alone, The Nash sent more than $1.2 million to support education statewide, followed by another $1.2 million in July. These contributions help strengthen public education across New Hampshire, reinforcing The Nash’s role as a community partner with a long-term vision.

Each donation from The Nash Casino reflects a carefully cultivated Nashua local partnership that is built on trust, shared values, and lasting impact.

So, while charitable gaming remains at the core of its mission, The Nash also contributes to the overall vitality of Nashua. It adds to the energy surrounding community events in Nashua and supports a shared sense of local pride. Every single visit plays a part in sustaining the charitable model that fuels our community.

The Nash Casino redefines what it means to be a gaming destination\! With its record-breaking charitable support and meaningful Nashua local partnerships, the casino has proven that success is best when it’s shared.
